youtube_short.title: The Credit Score Tier Banks Hide From You
title_alternatives: Why 760 Is the Real Magic Number (Not 750)
Miss This Score By 1 Point = $23,000 Gone
youtube_short.description: Everyone's chasing 750, but banks use a completely different pricing tier — and it's at 760. On a $400K loan, the gap between 759 and 760 is $23,000 in extra interest over the life of the loan. Here's the wild part: 31% of Americans are stuck in the 700-759 range without even knowing they're in the wrong bracket. Two fastest moves to cross the line: drop your credit utilization below 6% and request a credit limit increase — no new accounts needed. Check your score today. #creditscore #mortgage #personalfinance #moneytips #creditbuilding
